title: UntamedDogBreeding
description: Breed untamed dogs/wolves for random varients!
body:
🐾 UntamedDogBreeding Mod
UntamedDogBreeding is the ultimate solution for servers looking to make dog trading and breeding more exciting and dynamic. This mod completely redefines how players interact with their canine companions by introducing a unique mechanic — the ability to breed two untamed dogs.

When two untamed dogs are bred, the result is a random variant, meaning every new pup is a surprise! You never know what traits, colors, or personalities you’ll get, making each breeding session unpredictable and fun. These pups can then be sold to other players or tamed to become loyal companions, giving your server a thriving dog economy and endless gameplay possibilities.

Whether you’re running a roleplay server, a survival world, or a bustling marketplace, UntamedDogBreeding adds depth, creativity, and excitement to your community. It’s not just a mod — it’s a new way to experience the wild side of dog breeding.
